q1_issues.issue: 'ground feathers' is fused into the compound kind ground_feather (statements 0-1, with the modifier genus (Inheritance ground_feather ground)), but the adjective+noun fusion licence covers only a term of art, nationality/origin adjective, role title or material adjective, and a participial state modifier is none of those — cf. 'a laminated worktop' -> (Member sk_worktop_1 laminated), the split form, which on a plural distributes over the members instead; the modifier genus also falls outside the three exposure categories (gradable / positional-cardinal / material).

notes: Around and Against are obliques named after their own prepositions and so licensed. The whenever routing on indefinite participants, 'a Keeper' as a lowercase common-noun kind with no Name atom, 'lit' as its own participial-adjective atom, and the referring-use 'keeper' correctly getting no (can keep) capability are all right.
